command:
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-baseline.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Generates a file-integrity baseline for /etc.
set -e
BASE_DIR=/var/lib/etc-integrity-baseline
TARGET=/etc
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"

# Per-file metadata: path | type | mode | uid | gid | size | mtime
find "$TARGET" -xdev -exec stat --format '%n|%F|%a|%u|%g|%s|%Y' {} + | sort > "$TMP/metadata.txt"

# SHA-256 of every regular file's contents
find "$TARGET" -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort -k2 > "$TMP/sha256.txt"

mv "$TMP/metadata.txt" "$BASE_DIR/metadata.baseline"
mv "$TMP/sha256.txt" "$BASE_DIR/sha256.baseline"
rmdir "$TMP"

{
  echo "generated_at=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  echo "boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
  echo "host=$(hostname)"
  echo "file_count=$(wc -l < "$BASE_DIR/sha256.baseline")"
  echo "metadata_count=$(wc -l < "$BASE_DIR/metadata.baseline")"
} > "$BASE_DIR/baseline.info"

chmod 600 "$BASE_DIR"/metadata.baseline "$BASE_DIR"/sha256.baseline "$BASE_DIR"/baseline.info
echo "Baseline written to $BASE_DIR"
cat "$BASE_DIR/baseline.info"
EOF
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-baseline.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-baseline.sh | head -5

command:
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-check.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Compares current /etc state against the stored baseline and reports changes.
set -e
BASE_DIR=/var/lib/etc-integrity-baseline
TARGET=/etc
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"

if [ ! -f "$BASE_DIR/sha256.baseline" ] || [ ! -f "$BASE_DIR/metadata.baseline" ]; then
  echo "No baseline found in $BASE_DIR. Run etc-integrity-baseline.sh first." >&2
  exit 1
fi

find "$TARGET" -xdev -exec stat --format '%n|%F|%a|%u|%g|%s|%Y' {} + | sort > "$TMP/metadata.now"
find "$TARGET" -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort -k2 > "$TMP/sha256.now"

echo "=== Added or removed files/paths (metadata diff) ==="
diff "$BASE_DIR/metadata.baseline" "$TMP/metadata.now" || true

echo
echo "=== Content changes (sha256 diff) ==="
diff "$BASE_DIR/sha256.baseline" "$TMP/sha256.now" || true

rm -rf "$TMP"
EOF
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-check.sh
echo OK
